lead.headline: Waivers broke your way: Diggs claimed, Metcalf added free
lead.deck: The lineup is the projection lineup; the cost is a bench with three bye players.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. AVIATO's bench now carries three players on bye — Josh Allen, Bhayshul Tuten and Stefon Diggs — so if a starter is hurt in practice this week, the only cover is Alvin Kamara at running back and DK Metcalf at receiver. The overnight waiver run gave AVIATO Diggs for Terry McLaurin, whose season is over, and the Broncos D/ST for the Patriots; Metcalf went unclaimed and was added free at 07:55Z for Tyler Allgeier. The lineup as set is the projection lineup, 130.8 against JuiceJam's 90.2, and ESPN makes AVIATO a 72% favourite. Nothing to do until Friday's practice reports.
